title: The Navy Snowflake Christmas Dog Gift Basket

intro: The dog gets a stocking. I will not be taking questions. This one is navy and white: a cable knit snowflake sweater, a velvet stocking with a gold paw, five Christmas squeaky toys, a blue dots treat jar, a snowflake collar with a bow tie and a ceramic bowl that says Bone Appetit. He does not care. I care enough for both of us.
